questions.text: Does the plan include specific actions for climate adaptation and resilience?
questions.answer: The local government's plan does indeed include specific actions for climate adaptation and resilience. Planning responses involve using legislation and regulations to reduce vulnerability and increase resilience to climate change and sea-level rise. For instance, land projected to become more prone to flooding can be designated as suitable only for certain types of development. Engineering responses involve capital works such as seawalls and levees to protect coastal areas. The plan also discusses the need for ongoing monitoring of the coast to provide the basis for timely decision-making. Furthermore, the plan outlines an adaptation strategy for the period 2021-2031, with a focus on managing sea level rises to 2050 and considering the longer-term threat projected for 2100. The strategy also includes the development of a new master plan for certain areas.
